tb21_profile.skill: End-to-end Python packaging: author a package with correct name/version/__init__ exports, build a distribution, serve it behind a PEP 503 simple index on a port, and install it back with pip --index-url
tb21_profile.domain: Python packaging ecosystem: setuptools/pyproject, wheel/sdist, pypiserver, pip index resolution, localhost HTTP service
tb21_profile.task_form: build/packaging plus configure-a-service, built from scratch and verified by a single pip install command succeeding

notes: This is the best-covered TB2.1 task of the five. Recursive-Task-Synthesis contains roughly 180 near-duplicates of the build-wheel / run-pypiserver-on-8080 / pip-install-into-a-venv workflow; I picked the ten that actually build from source and exercise the /simple index rather than the many variants that only read a version string from an already-running server. TerminalWorld contributes one near-identical task (tw_485539) plus wheel-build and registry round-trip tasks. SWE-Rebench is unusually strong on domain here (setuptools, pip, packaging, twine, devpi, bandersnatch) even though its task_form is always bug-fix, and bandersnatch's PEP 700 simple-index work is the only task in the whole pool about implementing the index protocol itself. SWE-Smith is the weak corpus: no packaging repos beyond pipdeptree and conan, so ranks 5-10 there are gunicorn/conan tasks scored 1-2. Note the boilerplate trap in TMax: hundreds of tasks mention 'HTTP server on port 8080', which is retrieval noise, not transfer; I only kept TMax tasks whose graded work is Python packaging.
